scope: Partial interactive review of the English interface: native PDF file picker and initial open-document editor. Further interactions and the other seven locale variants remain pending after the native automation service stopped responding.

preparation.provenance: Existing isolated-copy preparation manifest and hashes rechecked before the separate interactive observations recorded below. Preparation alone does not establish a GUI review.

review_method.required: Use native CUA to interact with each running isolated app. Inspect rendered screenshots together with the accessibility hierarchy.
review_method.screenshot_hash_policy: Hash actual retained screenshot bytes only. The English editor screenshot was displayed as a CUA tool image, but its in-session bytes were lost when the CUA kernel reset. Its byte count and hash remain null; no local screenshot path is inferred.
review_method.screenshot_retention: Screenshot bytes may remain in the live CUA JavaScript session and be displayed as tool image attachments. No local screenshot path is inferred or fabricated. Record the actual in-session capture identifier and byte-derived SHA-256.

actions: Open the synthetic PDF through the native file picker.
Expand application, File, Edit, View, Document, Window and Help menus.
Inspect visible localized titles and Undo/Redo.
Resize within the supported minimum and inspect compact controls.
Switch pages, search, contents and notes.
Use page navigation and inspect counts.
Expand long bookmark titles and exercise the sidebar selector fallback.
Visit each tool category.
Search for a localized tool title and clear the query.
Scroll to the final tool cards and inspect wrapping and disabled states.
Open Preferences.
Inspect author, stroke, cache, recovery and keyboard shortcuts.
Scroll to the final option and inspect long labels.
Select Note, Text and Draw and inspect style controls.
Open keyboard annotations and inspect selection, position and dimensions.
Create and undo a synthetic annotation without saving over the fixture.
Add the synthetic input PDFs.
Inspect ordering and page-range controls.
Generate an in-memory preview and inspect destination/save labels.
Expand the split-method selector.
Inspect ranges, quantity, naming and separator controls.
Generate an in-memory preview and inspect output labels.
Expand the page-layout method selector.
Inspect N-up, booklet, poster and overlay controls.
Inspect crop and numbering panels, units and preview explanations.
Expand recognition-language and processing selectors.
Scroll through the options and inspect all report columns.
Run or cancel synthetic local OCR and inspect status labels.
Open scanner settings; record absent hardware separately.
Expand the export-format selector.
Inspect text, image, HTML and CSV-related option layouts.
Open a destination picker and cancel or save only to a temporary audit output.
Search the synthetic fields.
Edit text and checkbox values, then undo or discard changes.
Inspect field creation and CSV filling labels.
Inspect properties, page labels, images, attachments, portfolio and layers.
Switch to original content and scroll to its last control.
Inspect long descriptions and explanatory messages.
Inspect identity selection, signing reason and offline verification labels.
Scroll to the final notice.
Do not infer certificate signing or trust verification from an empty identity list.
Expand the profile picker and inspect all eleven profile labels.
Validate the synthetic PDF locally.
Expand rule filters and inspect selected rule details and incomplete-coverage messages.
Inspect report export controls.

limitations: Only the English file picker and initial open-document editor interaction were observed. No locale variant completed the full planned interactive checklist.
The English editor image was displayed as a tool attachment; screenshot bytes were lost on CUA kernel reset, so no byte hash, byte count or local image file is asserted.
Expanded menus, search, minimum-width states and every other planned panel remain pending.
The post-timeout app state and closure of the English audit app remain unverified.
The final fixture hash recheck remains unavailable; the earlier preparation hash is retained without claiming a final immutability check.
Native component snapshots are separate historical evidence and do not fill missing interactive checks.
Scanner acquisition and certificate signing need separate hardware or test identities.
This localization review establishes no complete VoiceOver audit or complete ISO PDF/A conformance validation.
